transcript.title: Opening
transcript.text: Good morning Rushil Bhatia. Here is your daily news for Friday, October 16. In today's briefing: top headlines, bhopal and madhya pradesh, business and markets, money, tax and personal finance, science and technology, development and policy, across india, around the world. Let's begin.

transcript.title: Top headlines
transcript.text: First, the stories leading the news this morning. 'Lacks common sense': Ashwin blasts India over Kuldeep's exclusion. Former India spinner R Ashwin criticised the team management for dropping Kuldeep Yadav from the last two T20Is against the West Indies, saying the decision "lacks a bit of common sense." Ashwin argued Kuldeep's variations troubled the visiting batters and could have saved India 15–20 runs. However, he supported Kuldeep's exclusion in Indore due to the ground's small dimensions. Why New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani wants 15 percent of whatever NYU's new quantum lab invents. New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani has committed $29.2 million to NYU's Quantum Fabrication Facility (QFab) in Manhattan, set to open in 2030. In return, the city gets 15 percent of NYU's proceeds from intellectual property created with city-funded tools, plus three advisory board seats. Backed by $284 million in total funding, the new quantum lab will train CUNY students and support more than 100 companies. Meet Gabriella Rothberg, 17, co-inventor of patented genetically engineered tomato. A sandwich idea at 15 led Miami student Gabriella Rothberg to develop genetically engineered tomatoes designed to produce heme, an iron-containing molecule associated with meat flavour. Now 17, she is listed alongside her father on a US patent issued in June 2026. The project remains experimental, with taste and nutritional benefits yet to be established. 3 children, teacher killed in US school shooting; 16-year-old shooter found dead. Three children aged 5, 8 and 11, along with a teacher, were killed in a shooting at an elementary school in Bend, Oregon, on Thursday, police said. 'Jailer 2' box office collection: Rajinikanth's film earns rupees 59.70cr net in India. Rajinikanth's 'Jailer 2' was released on October 15 and generated impressive opening day earnings. The film collected rupees 59.70 cr net in India and rupees 70.25 cr gross from local shows. Its overall worldwide gross reached rupees 125.25 cr, including rupees 55 cr from international markets. The Tamil version of 'Jailer 2' contributed significantly to the box office performance with high occupancy rates. If every citizen becomes a journalist, it will create problems for all, says SC. Supreme Court Thursday said it will be problematic if every citizen becomes a journalist as PILs sought protection of the right to freedom of expression of freelancers, independent journalists and reel-makers who descend in large numbers at protest venues already teeming with hordes of accredited reporters from registered media houses. We are not in an ivory tower and can't be browbeaten: CJI on oppn plea challenging SIR. Supreme Court Thursday sought responses from EC, CEC Gyanesh Kumar and election commissioners S S Sandhu and Vivek Joshi on a petition filed by INDIA bloc functionaries led by Rahul Gandhi alleging irregularities in SIR, arbitrary deletion of voters, undemocratic functioning of the poll panel and flaws in EVM use, even as it slammed the suggestion that the court could be browbeaten by deploying crowds. Indiana teen brothers save grandmother and 2 kids from pond. During a tense moment in Carmel, Indiana, two brothers displayed extraordinary bravery by rescuing a grandmother and her grandchildren from a pond. Their ordeal began when a pushchair slipped into the water, triggering panic. The older brother dove in, employing life-saving measures that successfully revived a two-year-old boy who had momentarily lost consciousness. The brothers will receive community recognition for their courageous actions at the next city council meeting. After Jio's listing, RIL could topple Tata as India's most valuable group. In the biggest reshuffle in the country's corporate rankings in decades, Reliance Industries (RIL) Group is all set to overtake Tata Group as India's most valuable conglomerate, once Jio Platforms lists. Woman seeks $250 refund after $350 deep clean left home dirty. Michigan woman Kimberly Kemper is seeking a $250 refund after paying $350 for a deep clean. She says dishes, walls and baseboards were left dirty and the cleaner failed to return for a promised re-clean. Business owner Cecilia Bodart offered a $100 refund, apologised for poor communication and maintained the work warranted payment. Michael Dell loses $20 billion in one day after Barclays downgrade. Michael Dell experienced a substantial decline in net worth, dropping more than $20 billion in just one day. This decline was prompted by a major decrease in his company's stock value following an analyst downgrade. Earlier this year, Dell's net worth had notably increased, bringing him closer to the highest billionaires in the world. Uttarakhand minister files FIR against husband, alleges assault, plot to kill her. Uttarakhand cabinet minister Rekha Arya lodged an FIR against her husband, Girdhari Lal Sahu, also known as Pappu Girdhari, at Garhi Cantt police station on Thursday evening, accusing him of physical assault, cheating, forgery and conspiring to kill her.

transcript.text: Moving to business, the economy and the markets. With inflation rising, will Warsh keep investors guessing?. Omitting forward guidance doesn't mean that Warsh has to go quiet, writes Fabio Natalucci. Pernod Ricard India sales grow 19 percent in Sep quarter; IPO plan awaits approval. French spirits maker Pernod Ricard, which on Thursday reported a 19 per cent sales growth in India for the September quarter, said its proposed initial public offering (IPO) in the country remains under discussion and is awaiting board approval. Pernod Ricard said double-digit sales growth in the first quarter of financial year 2027 in the India market, its second largest globally after the US, is "driven by strong demand and continuing premiumisation" as "the market continues to enjoy dynamic consumer fundamentals". Pernod Ricard's financial year runs from July 1 to June 30. "Growth is broad-based across the portfolio, with imported spirits in very strong double-digit growth, including Jameson, Absolut and Ballantine's, and with strong double-digit growth from Seagram's whiskies Royal Stag and Blenders Pride," said the company's earnings statement. Reliance Industries, BSE lead mutual fund buys in September, shows data. Mutual funds invested nearly rupees 6,000 crore in Reliance Industries in September, making it the most-bought stock, followed by BSE with inflows exceeding rupees 5,500 crore. But what explains this curious pattern? CAS review: Sebi announces last 30-minute VWAP method for settlement. The Australian dollar touched the lowest level since early July, extending its decline after domestic labor data pushed traders to scale back expectations of interest rate increases from the Reserve Bank of Australia. South Indian Bank's net profit rose 21.3 percent to rupees 426 crore in Q2FY27 as net interest income grew 38 percent to a record rupees 1,116 crore, while gross NPAs declined to 1.24 percent Fund Managers Quit to Trade Their Own Money in Taiwan Stock Boom. Nifty gains 1.66 percent as IT stocks, private banks and Reliance rally despite a sell-off in Asian technology shares; broader market breadth stays weak, with smallcap indices falling. Gold rallied, bolstered by lower US Treasury yields as investors sought safety in bonds following an equity selloff. In freefall! Yes Bank crashes 20 percent after SC ruling on AT-1 bond write-off. The dispute stems from the RBI-led reconstruction plan for Yes Bank in March 2020, under which AT1 bonds worth more than rupees 8,300 crore were written down. transcript.title: Money, tax and personal finance
transcript.text: Now to your money — taxes, savings and personal finance. DA hike after Dussehra? Will government announce dearness allowance increase after October 20?. Central government employees are anticipating a dearness allowance increase following the cabinet meeting scheduled for October 21. The government usually announces the DA hike during its regular Wednesday meetings. Recent inflation data suggests that the DA could rise significantly based on calculations from the retail inflation index. Employee associations have urged prompt action due to rising living costs affecting their finances. Millions hit by data breach in Japan: How cyber insurance can protect you against such risks , check costs, coverage. Rising cyberattacks and online fraud underscore the risks of identity theft and financial loss. Personal cyber insurance may cover eligible incidents, including phishing and unauthorised transactions. Here's all you need to know. WhatsApp scam alert: How replying 'No' to fake bank debit message can empty your bank account. Hyderabad reported incidents of WhatsApp message fraud causing victims to lose significant amounts of money. A chartered accountant lost lakhs after responding to a fraudulent message regarding a bank transaction. Similarly, two retired principals lost rupees 64 lakh due to scams in which one of them was misled into updating their KYC information. Authorities advise against responding to such messages and recommend contacting official channels. Centre approves 30-day bonus for government employees: Check eligibility, rupees 6,908 payout and service rules. The Centre has approved a 30-day ad-hoc bonus for eligible Central government employees for 2025-26. The payout can reach rupees 6,908 under the rupees 7,000 monthly calculation ceiling, with pro-rata payments for shorter service and separate eligibility rules for casual labourers. A retired LIC employee won ITAT Jaipur relief on rupees 9.04 lakh in leave encashment after the tax department restricted her exemption to rupees 3 lakh. The ruling examines whether the enhanced rupees 25 lakh limit introduced in 2023 can benefit employees who retired earlier. Gold price forecast: Why investors expect record highs within 2 years. For now, investors see continued central bank buying and demand for safe-haven assets as key supports for bullion. However, predictions of fresh record highs remain forecasts rather than guarantees. This feature simplifies account creation without the need for a physical bank visit. Salary hikes may not increase savings if lifestyle expenses rise alongside income. Here are five money habits young professionals should watch, from lifestyle inflation to emergency fund planning. Homeowner sold redeveloped flat for rupees 1.95 crore, paid no income tax, received a tax notice; wins relief in ITAT Mumbai. After redevelopment of housing society, homeowner sold his flat for rupees 1.95 crore, pays no tax, got tax notice, wins case in ITAT Mumbai for this reason EPFO extends September 2026 PF filing deadline to 31 October: What employees should check. EPFO has extended the deadline for employers to file September 2026 PF returns and deposit contributions to 31 October from 15 October. The extension follows the revision of the PF wage ceiling and gives employers more time to complete compliance formalities. 294 percent return on SGB premature redemption date: Gold bond turns rupees 1 lakh investment into rupees 3.94 lakh. Sovereign Gold Bond: The Reserve Bank of India has announced that the premature redemption price for Sovereign Gold Bonds will be set for October 2026. These bonds can be redeemed five years after their issuance at a fixed price. This redemption value is determined by the average closing gold price from the preceding three days. Diwali bonus: Will your festive payout be taxed? What salaried employees need to know. Diwali cash bonuses from employers are taxed as salary at the employee's applicable tax rate. Here's when gifts are exempt from tax and how to report it in ITR. Widow pension delayed for months? Andhra Pradesh High Court directs payment of arrears from the date of application. The Andhra Pradesh High Court has directed authorities to pay widow pension arrears from the date of application, ruling that administrative delays cannot deprive eligible beneficiaries of their entitlement. The arrears must be paid within eight weeks. Homebuyer paid rupees 15 lakh for a rupees 10.41 lakh flat, builder then threatened and asked rupees 20 lakh more; he approached Consumer Commission and won a refund with interest. Mr Anwar believed that the flat would be delivered after disposal of the litigation. However, after waiting for another 3 years, he came to Patna (from USA) in September 2011 and went to the builder with his sister to inquire about the same.Allegedly, one of the directors of the construction company refused to hand over the flat, demanding another rupees 20 lakh for possession, and threatened them.
